manifest.title: Zero velocity. Nonzero acceleration.
manifest.summary: Shows vertical toss motion with side-by-side height visualization and velocity-time graph.
manifest.description: Left, a ball moves vertically on a scale from 0 to 2.2 m with arrows for velocity and acceleration alongside a readout callout. Right, the velocity-time graph shows a linear decrease with constant downward slope -g.
assumptions: No air resistance, up is positive.
